# Project Configuration: Self-Healing Microservice Architecture Portal

## Tech Stack
- Framework: Next.js 14+ (App Router)
- Language: TypeScript
- Features: Middleware, Custom Layouts, Portal Scaffolding

## Architecture Rules
- All routing must use the `app/` directory.
- Implement strict TypeScript types for all layouts and page props.
- Keep middleware lightweight to avoid latency in microservice communication.
